title: Phase Noise Measurement
text: Compute phase noise at specific frequency offset vectors, 1 input; {Resolution bandwidth (Hz)} sets the smallest positive frequency that can be resolved, {No. of spectral averages} sets the number of spectral averages, {Hold off time (s)} sets the delays measurement analysis to avoid, {Frequency offset vector (Hz)} sets the frequency points relative to fundamental frequency where phase noise is calculated, {Specify target} sets the target phase noise vector, {Phase noise vector (dBc/Hz)} sets the target phase noise profile for given frequency offset vector, {Set stop time} sets the recommended minimum simulation stop time as model stop time, {Plot phase noise} and {Export measurement results}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Resolution bandwidth (Hz)
params.values: Smallest positive frequency that can be resolved 30e3 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: No. of spectral averages
params.values: Number of spectral averages 4 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Hold off time (s)
params.values: Delays measurement analysis to avoid transients 0 (default) | real nonnegative scalar

params.name: Frequency offset vector (Hz)
params.values: Frequency points relative to fundamental frequency where phase noise is calculated [30e3 100e3 1e6 3e6 10e6] (default) | real valued vector

params.name: Specify target
params.values: Specify target phase noise vector off (default) | on

params.name: Phase noise vector (dBc/Hz)
params.values: Target phase noise profile for given frequency offset vector [-300 -300 -300 -300 -300] (default) | real valued vector

params.name: Set stop time
params.values: Set recommended minimum simulation stop time as model stop time button

params.name: Plot phase noise
params.values: Plot phase noise profile of input signal button

params.name: Export measurement results
params.values: Export measurement results after simulation button
